CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.megatouch_frozen_stake()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF OLD.game_type IN('ptown-words','quintzee','eleven-up','tri-towers','run21','royal-flash','take-two','trip-flip','boxdrop','race-poker','battle-31','six-card-golf') AND NEW.config IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.config THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'megatouch:configuration_frozen';END IF;RETURN NEW;
END $function$
